concepts.title: What is ACE?
concepts.lead: Three ways to look at one decision. Tap a letter.
agency.name: Agency
connection.name: Connection
exchange.name: Exchange
agency.heading: Your ability to decide and act.
agency.body: In the conditions you face, you spend energy to decide and act: to maintain your state or change it.
agency.example: Hedayat fears Anonymous may be a hacker, yet wants to understand ACE. He reopens their chat and asks questions.
connection.heading: Your decisions meet other people.
connection.body: Your values, wishes, expectations and boundaries meet theirs. Connection means paying attention to both sides.
connection.example: Saman wants to read Hedayat’s writing. Hedayat keeps his notes private and promises him the first look at the draft.
exchange.heading: What you give. What you receive.
exchange.body: Time, care, skills or money can change hands. Is it a gift, a commitment to return something later, or payment? Make expectations clear.
exchange.example: Hedayat receives a painting from Saman as a birthday gift. The €15 he lends his neighbor Sebastian, however, is expected back.
concepts.note: Start with Agency: how does a decision become an action?
duration: A few clicks. A fresh perspective.
pdaf.title: From a pause to an action.
pdaf.lead: PDAF: four moments in a decision. Tap to follow the loop.
preparation.name: Preparation
decision.name: Decision
action.name: Action
feedback.name: Feedback
preparation.heading: Notice what is happening.
preparation.body: Before deciding, notice your inner feelings and the signals around you. What is the situation, and what do you understand about it?
preparation.example: For two nights, Hedayat’s sound system has disturbed his sleep and his neighbors’. He looks through its settings.
decision.heading: Choose what you will do.
decision.body: Given what you know and the energy you have, choose a way to maintain or change your state.
decision.example: Hedayat decides to try updating the sound system’s firmware, hoping to stop the nightly disturbance.
action.heading: Put your choice into practice.
action.body: A decision takes shape through action. Use your energy to carry out what you chose.
action.example: Using the remote, Hedayat starts the update. The sound system restarts when it finishes.
feedback.heading: Notice what comes back.
feedback.body: What changed? How do you feel? Feedback gives you information for your next round of Preparation.
feedback.example: At 3:03 a.m., the music blares again. The update hasn’t solved the problem; Hedayat pulls the plug.
pdaf.note: Feedback brings you back to Preparation.
phases.title: What kind of choice is this?
phases.lead: Four ways to use your ability to decide and act. Tap a card.
exploration.name: Exploration
stabilization.name: Stabilization
expansion.name: Expansion
integration.name: Integration
exploration.heading: Try an unfamiliar path.
exploration.body: Spend energy on something whose outcome you do not yet know.
exploration.example: In his museum dream, Hedayat enters a mysterious theater despite Ava’s hesitation. He has no idea what waits inside.
stabilization.heading: Make something dependable.
stabilization.body: Maintain your state, or adjust conditions to preserve it. Repetition and practice can make a skill easier.
stabilization.example: During blackouts, Hedayat connects his solar batteries; when power returns, he disconnects them. He changes the setup to keep his home running.
expansion.heading: Create with a skill you have.
expansion.body: Develop an existing ability through creativity and discover more possibilities within it.
expansion.example: Hedayat improvises on his setar while Yulia improvises a dance. He uses a skill he already has to create something new.
integration.heading: Find what gives it meaning.
integration.body: Examine the values behind your choice. What matters to you, and how does it connect you with others?
integration.example: A better-paid job tempts Hedayat. He questions what loyalty to his team and working for a free Internet mean to him.
phases.note: These phases are not a fixed sequence. Your situation shapes which ones you need.
play.title: Would you like to play?
play.lead: One everyday situation. More than one possible choice.
play.body: Take ACE into a game. Explore a situation, make a choice, and see what changes.
play.novel: From the world of ACE.await, a novel by Hedayat Abedijoo.
